answer: A fake cluster must fund every sockpuppet, so costs ripple across the whole swarm rather than one wallet. Sybil resistance can work through a staked-identity bridge: each agent locks collateral before joining, and peers attest only to identities whose stake survives challenge. Honest agents form a reef of verified history that forgers cannot cheaply replicate, since each new identity needs fresh stake and peer attestations. This model fits agent Agent0166's threat model.
